UploadedFile.title: UploadedFile
UploadedFile.description: Metadata for files stored in Firebase Cloud Storage by administrators

id.description: Unique identifier for the uploaded file record

fileType.description: MIME type or file category of the uploaded file

fileSize.description: Size of the file in bytes

storagePath.description: Full path of the object inside Firebase Storage bucket

downloadURL.description: Public or authenticated download URL for the file

uploadedAt.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded

uploadedBy.description: User ID of the administrator who uploaded the file

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Administrator profile mapping custom User ID to Firebase Authentication email

username.description: Custom administrator User ID used for login

/adminUsers/{userId}.description: Collection of administrator profiles for username resolution
